visual_action: A close-up shot of Ketanji Brown Jackson speaking at a microphone during a hearing. She is wearing glasses and a purple blazer.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is the only person shown speaking throughout the video, which is labeled "Judge Jackson's Opening Statement".

spoken_summary: Ketanji Brown Jackson commits that, if confirmed, she will work to support and defend the Constitution. She states that she has been a judge for nearly a decade and takes her duty to be independent very seriously. She says, "I decide cases from a neutral posture... without fear or favor, consistent with my judicial oath."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of clear, spoken dialogue with no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static, talking-head shot with no edits or cuts.
central_claim: Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson is a dedicated and impartial jurist who will uphold the Constitution if confirmed to the Supreme Court.
intended_effect: To showcase Judge Jackson's qualifications and judicial philosophy in her own words, thereby building support for her confirmation.
